paragraphs: The day begins with physical and skills training, followed by planning exercises and team rehearsals. The afternoon includes equipment inspections and live-fire training. Before missions, teams review routes and plans. During operations, members rely on each other, then complete after-action reviews and psychological decompression after returning.

In short: complete difficult missions in extreme environments. Duties include reconnaissance, direct action, coordination, equipment maintenance, team leadership, and after-action reviews. Combining physical and mental demands, special forces serve as highly mobile military spearheads.
